formName: Ways To Get In Touch With You
formDescription: Collects the applicant's preferred contact methods, used to follow up on the request and deliver records. At least one form of contact (a phone number, an email, or a complete mailing address) must be provided, though no single field is individually marked required.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Required for electronic delivery of the response package. Pre-filled and disabled when authenticated via BC Services Card (changed via the BC Services Card account instead).

province.title: Province/State
province.description: Applicant's mailing address province or state.

postal.title: Postal/ZIP code
postal.description: Applicant's mailing address postal or ZIP code.

notes: At least one of: email, phonePrimary, phoneSecondary, or a complete address (all of address/city/province/country/postal) must be provided to continue; enforced in component logic, not per-field validators.
